name: Lakshmi Vilasa Rasa (Swarn Yukt)

sections.overview:
Lakshmi Vilasa Rasa (Swarn Yukt) 
 Reference: Rasa Tantra Sara and Siddha Prayog Sangraha, Edition 13, page no 427-428 
 Lakshmi Vilasa Rasa (Swarn Yukt) is an ayurvedic preparation prepared by the combination of various natural ingredients. It is used in the treatment of severe and chronic diseases such as skin diseases, diabetes, elephantiasis etc.
sections.ingredients:
12 gm of each of ingredient:- 

 Swarna bhasma 
 Ropya bhasm 
 Abhraka Bhasma 
 Tamra bhasma 
 Vanga Bhasma 
 Lauh bhasma 
 Mandoor bhasam 
 Kantlauh bahsma 
 Nag bahsma 
 Sudh bachnabh bhasma 
 Mukta bhasma 

 132 gm of:- 

 Ras Sindoor 

 Method of Preparation 
 Mix all the ingredients with honey and flatten it in a big circular container. Keep it for drying in sunlight. Now heat this mixture in the presence of fire. Let it for cooling and triturate with chitrakmool kwath (decoction). Tablets of 65 mg are made.
sections.dose:
¼ to 1 tablet 2 times in a day with honey, chyavanprash, pippali choorna, milk or as per rugnavastha. 
 Mahalaxmi Vilas Ras Uses 

 Lymphadenopathy 
 Diarrhea 
 Hernia 
 Skin diseases 
 Diabetes 
 Elephantiasis 
 Sinus 
 Non healing wounds 
 Fistula 
 Cough 
 Cold 
 Pthisis 
 Emaciation 
 Rhinitis 
 Hemorrhoids 
 Obesity 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Facial palsy 
 Ascites
sections.side_effects:
This medicine contains heavy metal ingredients, hence should only be taken under strict medical supervision. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
